reviews.text: I've seen Alex twice now for very technical cuts and she's nailed both of them! I've gotten so many compliments on my hair that I think I should carry her business cards with me! She's really nice and is very meticulous. I've had a hard time finding someone who is consistent and understands my wavy hair, and I'm so excited to have found Alex - HIGHLY recommend!

I love Kayci, She has been doing my hair for years and is the best! She’s so talented and always delivers with the best service. I definitely recommend coming here for a bright atmosphere, great conversations, and receiving the best quality and service!!
Love this Salon! Heather the owner is amazing and does a great job on my hair...for several years now! SAVVY sister for Life
